hypothesis_origin.reason_for_followup: Designed after observing the v2 negative result and post-hoc stale-claim diagnostics. It tests whether current-week reset semantics and decomposed official practice/game state avoid persistent-claim contamination.

negative_controls.identity_shuffle: Shuffle only the candidate current-week columns within season/week/position strata.
negative_controls.shifted_time_leakage: Move the next same-season player current-week state backward by one observed player row. This is a leakage-sensitivity diagnostic, never valid predictive evidence.

missingness_semantics.source_covered_player_absent: Current-week score fields remain null and explicit found flags are zero. Absence from the report is not hard-coded as healthy/full participation.
missingness_semantics.stale_prior_week_claims: Never carried into the current-week candidate features.
missingness_semantics.future_modified_rows: Excluded unless date_modified is at or before the 1.5-hour prediction cutoff.

multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg correction is applied jointly across all three registered v3 formulations.
confirmation_boundary: A formulation that passes every exploratory screen still requires an independent untouched or prospective confirmation experiment before it can become eligible for manual activation review.
